title: Refuse raw invisible format characters in tracked source
body: Outcome: npm run preflight refuses a raw invisible format character (U+200B-U+200F, U+2028-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+FEFF not at file start) in tracked src/, test/ and scripts/ files and names path:line. Evidence: while delivering t-dzyg447 (PR #198) the lead's Write tool turned the escape text for U+FEFF in test/brief/invisible-format.test.ts into a raw character; only a manual grep -P caught it; krn brief check covers briefs only. git grep at 2434eda finds none today, so the check starts green. Proof: new observer red at base by assertion.
